jobs.title: Assistant Product Manager- Protective Coatings
jobs.description:
The Assistant Product Manager – Protective Coatings plays a key role in managing and optimizing a global portfolio of functional coatings and pavement marking products. This position supports all stages of the product lifecycle, including portfolio strategy, product development, commercialization, market analysis, pricing, profitability management, and SKU optimization. The role partners closely with cross-functional teams including R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and Technical Services to develop business cases, coordinate product launches, monitor product performance, and identify opportunities for growth and portfolio expansion. The successful candidate will help drive revenue growth, margin improvement, market share gains, and customer satisfaction while ensuring products meet industry standards and customer needs in a competitive global marketplace.
This role is not remote/hybrid. This role will report to Sherwin-Williams offices in either Brecksville, OH or Minneapolis, MN.
This role will require up to 20% travel.
This position is also eligible for bonus incentive compensation awards based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.
EDUCATION:

- Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering , Chemistry, Materials Science, Business, Marketing, or related discipline.

Preferred:
- MBA or advanced technical degree.

- Professional certifications related to Product Management or Project Management.

- KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:

- Required:

- 5 + years of experience in research and development, project management, product management, portfolio management, marketing, technical services, or business development.

- Experience within coatings, construction materials, industrial products, specialty chemicals, or powder chemistry.

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and product launches.

- Preferred:

- Knowledge and experience with industrial coatings and chemistry

- Experience with industry standards and certification requirements

- Experience in multinational or matrix organizations
- Responsibilities:

-

- Portfolio Lifecycle Management

- Manage the Functional Coatings and Pavement Marking portfolio of products through all stages of the lifecycle

- Identify portfolio gaps and prioritize investment opportunities.

- Develop portfolio roadmaps for respective segments

- Monitor competitive product assortments, strategy, pricing, strengths and weaknesses, as well as trends in the industry

- Lead SKU rationalization and product portfolio optimization initiatives.

- Create Regional Product Lists with SKU detail and cost and pricing guidance

- Monitor product performance and profitability.

- Establish product positioning and value propositions.

- Manage Part Numbers, Packaging, and Labelling for Portfolio

- Collaborate with GSC to identify true Product costs to serve global and regional markets

- New Product Development and Commercialization

- Lead product development initiatives through the stage-gate process.

- Coordinate successful commercialization of new technologies and product enhancements.

- Develop business cases for new products and portfolio investments.

- Partner with R&D to define development priorities and specifications.

- Coordinate product testing, certification, and regulatory approval activities.

- Work with R&D to deliver technical documents including data sheets and technical documents for launch

- Coordinate field trial activities with Marcomm and Field Marketing to capture photo and video records

- Lead launch planning and post-launch performance reviews.

- Monitor adoption rates and customer feedback following launch.

- Cross Functional Leadership and Business Performance

- Collaborate with Supply Chain to ensure product availability and service levels.

- Partner with Procurement regarding raw material risks and sourcing strategies.

- Participate in portfolio reviews and business planning processes.

- Track revenue, margin, market share, and portfolio profitability metrics.

- Prepare executive-level performance updates and recommendations.
The Assistant Product Manager – Protective Coatings supports the management and growth of the Protective Coatings product portfolio by assisting with product lifecycle management, new product development, commercialization, market analysis, and cross-functional initiatives. Works closely with R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, and Marketing to drive portfolio performance, launch new products, and deliver business growth.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Enterprise Data & Insights
jobs.description:
The Enterprise Data & Insights - Lead Product Manager role is responsible for leading the development and launch of data products for all Corporate functions (HR, Finance, EHS, etc), from conceptualization through to end of life, using waterfall or agile methodologies.

The incumbent acts as a key liaison to their assigned product line(s) to ensure the Corporate functions are upskilled on and effectively leveraging the ED&I organizations data, tools and technology. The incumbent is an experienced professional with extensive knowledge and experience in product management and information technology principles, practices, and frameworks. In addition to defining product requirements and continuously refining the product strategy, the incumbent collaborates closely with key stakeholders across the organization, including business teams, technology product owners and technical teams to drive the development, implementation, and enhancement of new data products with a focus on optimizing product performance and customer experience. The incumbent will gain an understanding of the goals and objectives held by the Corporate functions to provide insights and recommendations for their data product and service offerings. The incumbent takes responsibility for the execution of various technology product development projects, including planning, scheduling, executing, and closing projects. They take responsibility for ensuring adherence to product timelines, budgets, quality standards, and customer needs. The incumbent is a key contributor to a culture of collaboration and contributes actively to the development and execution of the organization's overall strategy and vision, working closely with senior and executive leadership to achieve the organization's strategic objectives.
Position Requirements

Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration, or in lieu of a degree, or at least 9 years of experience in the field of technology product management

- 6+ years of experience in technology product management with experience in launching and managing successful products

- Extensive knowledge of product development and launch processes, including agile methodologies

- Extensive knowledge of production innovation methodologies and leading practices

- Ability to conduct advanced market research and analyze customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape

- Proven experience with hardware or software product development

- Extensive knowledge of user experience (UX) design principles and customer-centric design thinking

- Expertise in business processes, including IT, vendor management, and software development lifecycle

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical solutions into business language

- Must be at least 18 years of age

- Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without needing sponsorship for employment work visa status now or in the future.

Preferred

- Related certifications (e.g., PMI Certification, Certified Scrum Product Owner or Certified Product Manager)

- Supervisory or Team lead experience

- Data Strategy & Innovation

- Proven experience in analyzing data and developing insights to support business decision-making.

- Data Visualization Tools (e.g. Tableau, BO, MicroStrategy)

- Data Analysis Tools (e.g. Python, SQL, R, Excel)

Technical Skills

- Software Development Lifecyle (SDLC) Methodology

- Project Management Tools

- Product Analytics Tools

- Customer Relationship Management

- Market Research & Competitive Analysis

- Product Strategy & Planning

- Product Risk Management

- Modern Delivery

- Product Lifecycle Management

- Demand & Capacity Management

- Technology Domain Knowledge

- Product Optimization & Growth Strategy Development

- Product Requirements Gathering & Documentation

- Persona Creation & Journey Mapping

- Reporting Tools
- Partners with senior leaders to develop and execute product strategy, including product roadmaps, priorities, pricing, budgeting, positioning, and messaging​.

- Develop strategies to define product requirements in partnership with the business and work with cross-functional teams (engineering, design etc.) to ensure product vision is well understood and executed.​

- Establish and share perspective, to conduct market research and analysis on Corporate functions related data and products to identify customer needs, market trends and competitive threats.

- Drive strategies to define, track, and report on product metrics to measure success and prepare new strategy as needed.

- Develop strategies to shape and prioritize the product backlog and determine business expertise and understanding of customer needs.

- Plan and lead the product development process, from concept to launch, and guide the team to ensure products are delivered on time, on budget, and meet quality standards.

- Develop strategies to manage knowledge documentation in support of the product, and provide guidance as needed.

- Lead and communicate product updates and progress to stakeholders and executive leadership, including technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Establish and share strategies to build and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders and provide guidance to the team as needed.

- Plan and lead product performance and customer feedback and guide to identify areas for improvement and drive continuous product innovation.

This is not a remote position, and will report to our headquarters in Cleveland, OH.

Job duties include contact with other employees and access confidential and proprietary information and/or other items of value, and such access may be supervised or unsupervised. The Company therefore has determined that a review of criminal history is necessary to protect the business and its operations and reputation and is necessary to protect the safety of the Company’s staff, employees, and business relationships.

This position is also eligible for bonus based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.
